purpose: Research fixture for RTD-style attestations, miner/pool signal incentives, simulated prediction markets, and portfolio hedge alerts.
nextSettlement: Build a payload receipt for one signed attestation, verify the accepted transaction, then let the indexer derive signal state from accepted payloads.

incentiveRules.name: Useful early signal
incentiveRules.reward: Fee share or reputation gain when a signal arrives before public baseline sources and later resolves accurately.
incentiveRules.guard: Do not reward unverifiable claims or circular self-reported events.

incentiveRules.name: Calibration
incentiveRules.reward: Higher reputation for confidence scores that match eventual outcomes.

incentiveRules.name: Market consumption
incentiveRules.reward: Apps can pay sources whose signals are used in risk dashboards or simulated market updates.
incentiveRules.guard: Real-money settlement stays out of scope until legal, oracle, and dispute assumptions are explicit.

signals.claim: Observed a sharp short-window hashrate movement on TN12-like monitoring inputs.
signals.marketUse: Update simulated probability for a network-stress event.
signals.portfolioUse: Raise alert for portfolios concentrated in short-term miner revenue assumptions.
signals.rewardHint: Reward only if the signal beats baseline detection and later matches accepted network observations.

resolution.note: Fixture assumes the direction was useful, but magnitude was imperfect.

signals.claim: Public signals suggest a listing/event window, but evidence is weak and should not drive automatic trading.
signals.portfolioUse: Watchlist alert; no automatic position change.
signals.rewardHint: No reward until the claim is specific, sourced, and resolved.

resolution.note: Needs a concrete resolution source and date.

signals.claim: Pool operator is willing to test a signed off-chain signal feed before any coinbase payload policy.
signals.marketUse: Infrastructure readiness signal, not a tradeable event.
signals.portfolioUse: No direct hedge action; improves confidence in future signal supply.
signals.rewardHint: Reward integration work after signed messages can be verified and anchored.

resolution.note: Fixture marks willingness as verified, not production support.
